reviews.review_msg: Steven's background is primarily in fixed income, but his knowledge of equity investing is just class. Teaching is mostly oriented around a textbook plus some additional slides. Group projects are important so form a good team. Exams come from the textbook and few additional materials. I recommend you take his class if you actually like finance.
